fire_when: A positive finite-volume wired/free gap proves a positive infinite-volume gap.
silent_when: For a fixed bulk event A, gap_N(A)>=delta>0 for every outer N, with delta independent of N; pass the limit on A.
text: A positive finite-volume wired/free gap may vanish. Keep the event support fixed and prove a lower bound uniform in the outer volume before claiming critical coexistence. The q=3,p=1/2 path gap tends to zero.
